study.question: Does the stronger click AUC with both buy-to-context routes require their summed gradient direction, or can either single route recover it when given the same per-example context-gradient norm as the sum?
study.hypothesis: Let r and p be the buy residual and product route loss VJPs at their common concatenated context input. Earlier deletion controls alter direction and magnitude simultaneously. The provisional direction-complementarity hypothesis predicts that r+p remains better than both p*||r+p||/||p|| and r*||r+p||/||r|| at fixed architecture and training recipe. A matched single route recovering the both-route quality would weaken a directional-necessity explanation and motivate magnitude/optimizer attribution instead. This study may yield a simpler training update, but predicts no guaranteed improvement over the incumbent.

study.proposed_difference: Add a parameter-free two-output context identity only for the buy training branch. Its outputs feed residual and product modules separately, so backward receives their individual r and p vectors. Compute r+p, stable FP32 row norms and both norm-matched single-route alternatives in every cell. Return either matched product, matched residual, native sum or raw product to the shared context input. Other task context gradients add normally downstream. No branch output or private parameter is detached. Eval bypasses this node. Degenerate selected directions fall back to the native sum; zero sum norm yields zero. These intentional first-order surrogates do not claim higher-order or finite-difference correctness.
predictions: At common parameter/buffer state all four variants give identical four-task forward probabilities and buffer updates; parameter counts and RNG after construction match inherited sources.

For each nondegenerate buy row, matched single-route gradient norm equals ||r+p|| before sparse repeated-ID accumulation. Product_raw equals p and both equals r+p. Other task and private parameter gradients agree at common state.

If combined direction carries useful complementary information, both_sum_bridge exceeds BOTH norm-matched single routes in full-validation click AUC by at least 0.0001; this is a predeclared practical screening margin, not a significance threshold.

If a matched single route is within0.0001 of both and improves over its raw counterpart, route-deletion evidence is compatible with a magnitude/optimizer explanation. A matched cell exceeding both by0.0001 is a candidate for later cost and repetition checks.

Restored-vs-native difference with both is only+0.0000049430, changes sign with product-only(-0.0000482516) and residual-only(-0.0000121857), and is exactly zero in the isolated receipts. Therefore a general benefit of the summary surrogate is unestablished. The route-direction study freezes it for attribution.
